objective: Replace the eight avatar presets with a colour choice: initials on an inner colour with an outer ring, chosen from the team palette, in black text whenever a background is picked.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: FRONTEND-031 has merged to main. Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

User gains nullable avatar_inner_color and avatar_outer_color, returned by PublicUserOut, MeOut and the users public-profile interface, so feed authors and account search carry them. Both are null by default.

PATCH /users/me accepts each independently. Only keys from the palette's own list are valid: an outer key sent as inner, an inner key sent as outer, or an unknown key is a 422. Omitted means unchanged and null clears it. The two allowlists are Literal types in app.users.schemas, so the frontend's types come from the generated schema.
A frontend type-level test proves the generated schema's two unions equal the INNER_COLORS and OUTER_COLORS keys in frontend/src/lib/teamColors.ts, so npm run typecheck fails if the lists drift.

The presets are gone: profile_avatar_key is no longer accepted or returned, and AVATAR_OPTIONS, AvatarGeometry and data-avatar-key are removed. The migration drops the column. A user who had a preset becomes the default initials. Migration keeps every other value and its downgrade restores the column empty.
profile_picture_media_id and its rendering are unchanged, and setting a colour does not clear it.

Avatar renders the username's first character, as typed, in both sizes. No colours: exactly today's default. Inner set: that fill, with black text, always. Outer set: a ring in that colour; with no inner the text stays the default colour. Text on every inner colour meets 4.5:1.
The rule is one rule on every surface: own and public profile summaries, feed authors, account search results and the shell's account button show the same avatar.

ProfileSettings' avatar section keeps its fieldset, legend, Preview and Save. In place of the preset radios it has two labelled single-choice groups, Inner colour and Outer colour, each listing None then its palette only, as keyboard-operable radios with a visible selection that does not rely on colour alone: each choice shows its colour name. Each target is at least 24 by 24 CSS px, and Save is at least 44 px high.
The preview updates as the choice changes. A failed save restores the saved colours and shows the existing alert. Saving sends only the fields that changed.
At 320, 360 and 1280 CSS px the groups reflow without page-level horizontal overflow.

Browser rows at 360 and 1280, light and dark, on localhost test accounts only, reported with measurements or NOT DONE: default; inner only; outer only; both; save, failure and reset; the result on profile, feed and account search.
frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/USERS-005.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes. Entry growth is at most 2 KiB raw and 1 KiB gzip, and no output reaches 500,000 raw bytes.
No new dependency or third-party request. Colours come from the FRONTEND-031 tokens by name.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x01-users.md and 0x08-frontend.md replace the preset description.
